allFiles.description: True when --all-files ranked the files that are not code as well.

includeTests.description: True when --include-tests ranked the test files with the production code. Otherwise the test files are counted in dropped.tests.

complexityReport.description: The complexity plugin's report that supplied the complexity column, or null when the indentation proxy was used.

complexitySource.description: Where the complexity column came from: the complexity plugin's file report, or indentation complexity computed from the files at the analysed commit.

path.description: The file's path, or the component's name with --by component.

role.description: Whether the file is a test, by its language's naming conventions and the shared testPatterns. Only with --by file.

score.description: Rank percentile of frequency times rank percentile of complexity. null when complexity is unknown.

files.description: Files in the component. Only with --by component.

frequency.description: Revisions in the window. For a component, logical changes that touched it.

churn.description: Lines added plus lines deleted in the window.

ageDays.description: Whole days from the last revision to the analysed commit.

fixes.description: Logical changes in the window whose commit message is a fix under history.fixPatterns, counted once per file or component. A count of messages, not of defects.

fixShare.description: fixes over frequency. null with no revisions.

siblingTest.description: The test beside the file at the analysed commit, or null. Only with --by file.

findings.description: Every classification of the file. Only with --by file.
